raw_tokens.value: You gain a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (Geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks, Initiative checks and cannot be tracked on your chosen plane|FavoredTerrainPlains

You gain a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (Geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks when using these skills on your chosen plane. Likewise, you get a +%1 bonus on initiative checks when on that plane. If you desire, you leave no trail on that plane and cannot be tracked.|FavoredTerrainPlanes
